# Gourmet Carousel immutable official fixtures

- research-2026-10-01: five narrow linkage/listing/venue/operator/alias probes.
- research-details-2026-10-01: eight details from visible offers cards; parent listing replayed from the first capture.
- live-2026-10-01: one bounded ten-request structural acquisition after source-boundary tests passed.
- manifest.json: combined initial offline fixture mapping; no live calls.
- ownership.json: independent operator/domain declaration and separate merchant/venue evidence.

Every capture-provenance.json records requested/final URLs, capture/observation instant, status/type/bytes/SHA-256/purpose. Raw HTML is never formatted. The live capture uses the existing fetcher's frozen acquisition instant. No OCR, asset fetch, Telegram, geocoding or arbitrary recursive crawl.

Offline preview: `npm run direct-sources:preview -- --source gourmet_carousel_sg --fixture tests/fixtures/direct-sources/gourmet-carousel/live-2026-10-01/manifest.json`.

Publication remains disabled: service-page enumeration is unproven. The source-specific venue provider proves only the named Barista counter, never the separate Carousel buffet or every Gourmet service.
